title: Ajiro API endpoint file
description: One endpoint = one YAML file at api/<resource>/<method>-<path>.yaml. `source` is written by `ajiro-api scan` only; `tests` and `mock` are written by humans and AI agents and are never touched by scan.

version.description: Schema version of this file. Currently always 1.

id.description: Stable identifier, unique within the project (e.g. `users.create`, `todos.get`). Used by `depends_on`, snapshots (`api/__snapshots__/<id>/`) and the `test` filter.

summary.description: One-line summary shown in `list` and in generated docs.

tags.description: Free-form tags used to group endpoints (e.g. in OpenAPI export and HTML docs).

task.description: Ajiro task id this endpoint belongs to (Phase 3 integration), e.g. `TSK-012`.

depends_on.description: Endpoint ids that must run before this one. Their captured variables become available as `{{ name }}`. Use it for auth chains (e.g. `auth.login.create` captures `token`). Unknown ids are reported by `validate`.

tests.description: Test cases written by humans and AI. `scan` never touches this field. If empty, `ajiro-api test` runs an implicit `smoke` test (status < 500).

templateValue.description: Any JSON/YAML value. Strings may contain templates: `{{ var }}` (captured or environment variable), `{{ env.NAME }}` (from .env only), and built-ins `{{ $uuid }}`, `{{ $timestamp }}`, `{{ $timestampMs }}`, `{{ $isoDate }}`, `{{ $randomInt }}`, `{{ $randomEmail }}`.

valueMap.description: Map of name to value. Strings may contain templates such as `{{ var }}`.

stringMap.description: Map of name to string. Strings may contain templates such as `{{ env.API_TOKEN }}`.

request.description: The base request of the endpoint. Each test may override parts of it with `tests[].request`.

path.description: OpenAPI-style path starting with `/`, with `{param}` placeholders (e.g. `/users/{id}`).

params.description: Values for `{param}` placeholders in `path`. Templates allowed (e.g. `id: "{{ todoId }}"`).

headers.description: Request headers. Never write secrets here; use `{{ env.NAME }}`.

body.description: Request body. Any YAML value; objects/arrays are sent as JSON. Strings inside are templated.

requestOverride.description: Overrides applied on top of the endpoint `request` for one test case. `params`, `query` and `headers` are merged key by key; `body` objects are deep-merged (a `null` value removes the key); any other body type replaces the base body.

source.description: Where the route handler lives in the code. Written by `ajiro-api scan` only. Do not edit it by hand.

framework.description: Framework the route was detected in.

file.description: Source file path relative to the project root, `/`-separated.

line.description: Line number of the route definition.

test.description: One test case: the (overridden) request is sent and the response is checked against `expect`.

name.description: Test name, unique within the file. Also used for the snapshot file name (`api/__snapshots__/<id>/<slug>.json`).

capture.description: Variables to capture from the response for later tests and for endpoints that `depends_on` this one. Value: a JSONPath (`$.token`), `header:<Header-Name>`, `cookie:<cookie-name>` (a cookie from the `Set-Cookie` headers; always masked in logs), `status`, or `body` (the whole body).

only_env.description: Run only in these environments (names from ajiro-api.yaml). Empty or omitted = all environments.

expect.description: Assertions on the response. Omitted fields are not checked.

status.description: Expected HTTP status: one integer, or an array of accepted statuses.

headers.description: Header name (case-insensitive) to expected value. A value starting and ending with `/` is a regex (e.g. `/^application\/json/`).

ignore.description: JSONPaths excluded from `body.equals` and `body.snapshot` comparison (volatile values such as ids and timestamps).

bodyExpect.description: Body assertions. Several can be combined; all must pass. Prefer `match` + `schema` over `equals`.

equals.description: Exact match against the whole JSON body (after removing `ignore` paths). Brittle: prefer `match` and `schema`.

schema.description: JSON Schema the body must satisfy: a path relative to the endpoint YAML file (e.g. `./schemas/user.json`), or an inline schema object.

match.description: JSONPath to expected value (partial match). The expected value is a literal, or a matcher object with exactly one key: `$exists`, `$type`, `$regex`, `$contains`, `$len`, `$gt`, `$gte`, `$lt`, `$lte`, `$ne`, `$oneOf`.

snapshot.description: Compare the body with the stored snapshot `api/__snapshots__/<id>/<test-slug>.json`. Created on first run; update with `ajiro-api test -u`. Volatile values must be listed in `expect.ignore`.

contains.description: Substring that must appear in a non-JSON (text) body.

matcher.description: Matcher object for `expect.body.match` values. Exactly one key.

$exists.description: true: the path must exist; false: it must be absent.

$regex.description: Regular expression the string value must match.

$contains.description: String: substring. Array: must contain this element.

$len.description: Length of the array / string / object: an exact integer, or a numeric matcher object such as { "$gte": 1 }. For multi-node paths ([*], .., [?...]) the value is the array of all matches.

$gte.description: Value must be greater than or equal to.

$lte.description: Value must be less than or equal to.

$oneOf.description: Value must equal one of these.

mock.description: Sample responses served by `ajiro-api mock`. Select a scenario with `--scenario`, the `X-Ajiro-Scenario` header or `?__scenario=` (falls back to `default`).

body.description: Response body (any YAML value; sent as JSON).
